name: Alpaca Connectors Operator
description: Operates this repository's supported Alpaca asset, account, holdings, Universe, market-data, ETF weight signal, rebalance, and analytical ETF portfolio workflows through verified project tools.

extensions.description: Select whether message:send returns a completed message or an asynchronous task.

skills.name: Alpaca Asset Registration
skills.description: Inspect canonical Alpaca-backed Assets and plan or execute exact-symbol registration using a registered Account's Secret references.
examples: Plan registration for AAPL and NVDA through my registered Alpaca account.

skills.name: Alpaca Accounts And Holdings
skills.description: Register and maintain Alpaca Accounts by Secret name, then inspect or capture their ms-markets holdings snapshots.
examples: Register a paper account from these two Main Sequence Secret names and show its initial holdings.

skills.name: ETF Universes
skills.description: Maintain ETF extraction sources and registered Universes, then bulk materialize linked AssetCategory members and one observed weight frame.
examples: Preview and extract the components for this registered ETF Universe using my selected account.

skills.name: Alpaca Stock Bars
skills.description: Manage stored Alpaca bar configurations, resolve their configured Asset scope and migrated dataset, run updates, and query observations.
examples: Resolve this daily Universe-backed bars configuration and run its update Job.

skills.name: ETF Weight Signals
skills.description: Create, inspect, schedule, and run Universe-backed ETF weight signal configurations with one durable Job per configuration.
examples: Create a daily ETF weight signal for this Universe and account, then run it once.

skills.name: Analytical ETF Portfolios
skills.description: Manage calendar-event rebalance rules and analytical ETF portfolios built from stored weight signals and Alpaca bars, including history and statistics.
examples: Build and run an analytical ETF portfolio from this signal, bars configuration, and market-close rebalance rule.
